about: Measurements of class_series.jser by SynapseWeb/PyReconstruct at a pinned commit, written by tests/upstream_reference/generate.py. 'upstream' holds upstream's raw values; 'fork' holds the fork's expectation for each measure that differs on purpose, with the reason. Entries under 'synthetic' are made up inputs, not real traces.

generator.isolation: separate process, upstream's own Python run with -I; QSettings replaced by a class that raises

selection: Every trace upstream's Section loads from every section, alignment 'default', in section number, object name, loaded index order. Section.__init__ drops rows of fewer than two points and opens two-point rows. 'row' is the trace's row in the contour as the fixture stores it; 'index' is its position in the loaded contour, which is TraceData's index.
trace_data: Upstream ObjectData.addTrace builds each TraceData(trace, index, tform); measures are its getLength, getArea, getRadius, getCentroid and getFeret.
export: Upstream SeriesData.exportTracesCSV over the same TraceData, rows split on commas.

reduce_points_arguments.note: Points are scaled by mag and truncated to int32, simplified by cv2.approxPolyDP, then divided by mag.

merge_traces_arguments.conversion: pixels = np.rint(np.array(trace.points) / section.mag).astype(np.int32).tolist(), raw (untransformed) points, every section and object with two or more closed traces
merge_traces_arguments.note: This is the legacy grid merge, which upstream's field calls on screen pixel coordinates. The fork's current merge, mergeTracesInField, has no counterpart at this commit and is not compared here.

tool_output_digest: SHA-256 of json.dumps(output, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False)
points_digest: SHA-256 of json.dumps([[x, y], ...], separators=(',', ':')) of the loaded points

reasons.centroid-rounding-order: Upstream rounds the raw centroid to 6 decimals and then maps it; the fork maps the points and rounds the mapped centroid. Each is within 5e-7 of the exact value, so they differ by at most 5e-7 * (1 + |a| + |b|) per axis.
reasons.minimum-width: Upstream reports the closest antipodal pair of hull vertices; the fork reports the minimum width, the smallest gap between two parallel supporting lines (fork commit c9f27ab13f0e1b115d3bb1790533ea85bd8846c7). The width is never larger than any antipodal pair distance.
reasons.far-from-origin-precision: Upstream sums shoelace terms in raw coordinates, which loses a small trace far from the origin to rounding; the fork sums relative to the first point (fork commit 97713536552500a1ab2f6aff6df1b2b8b52926e7).
